newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says will support NCB's restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: MOF says will support NCB's restructuring plan.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will fully support Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's (NCB) ongoing restructuring plan, a MOF official said on Friday.
"I hear that NCB is now in the process of drawing up a restructuring plan and that it will be announced at some point. Once it comes out, we will fully support it," he told Reuters.
The official also said bank debentures issued by Japanese banks were secure and added that he did not expect any disruptions to financial markets because of concerns over NCB's financial health.
Earlier on Friday, Moody's Investors Service said it had cut its rating for NCB's bonds to Ba1 from Baa3.
Bonds which are rated Ba are judged to have speculative elements and their future cannot be considered well-assured, Moody's said.

"I really don't know what Moody's based their decision on. But it seems to be sceptical about (Japan's) monetary authorities. That's disappointing, but we have never in the past caused any trouble to depositors in the case of failures at financial institutions," the official said.
